item.title: Oversight chair rejects Clintons’ offer for Epstein testimony
item.description: Rep. James Comer of Kentucky, the Republican chair of the Oversight Committee, on Monday rejected an offer from Bill and Hillary Clinton to testify in the Jeffrey Epstein investigation, just days before an expected House vote on holding them in criminal contempt of Congress.

item.title: 21-year-old pleads guilty to Virginia Beach killing during marijuana sale
item.description: Cameron Mooty, 21, pled guilty last week to second degree murder and attempted robbery for the Dec. 2022 double shooting that began as a marijuana sale and ended in the killing of Evan Labella, 18, and injuring of his friend.

item.title: Portsmouth shooting leaves 2 injured, including 1 juvenile
item.description: Two people, including one juvenile are injured following a shooting in the 200 block Chowan Drive, according to a news release from the Portsmouth Police Department.

item.title: Salem High grad from Indiana leads Senior Bowl in rushing
item.description: Shortly after helping the Hoosiers win a national championship, Kaelon Black likely helped his NFL draft status with his performance in Mobile, Alabama.
